blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Residents across Metro Cebu and the rest of Cebu province should prepare for rain showers and thunderstorms through Tuesday, Oct. 13, as the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) continues to affect the Visayas, bringing possible flooding and landslides in areas hit by heavy rainfall.
